Home.title: SkillRadar | AI-Powered Tech Profile Optimizer
Home.description: Analyze your CV, match profiles with job requirements, and practice technical interviews. High-fidelity optimization for developers.
Home.heroTitle: Deconstruct and Optimize Your <bold>Tech Profile</bold> with AI
Home.heroSubtitle: Compare your CV against real job descriptions, close engineering skill gaps, and prepare for core mock interviews. Built by developers, for developers.
Home.feature1Desc: Instant breakdown of your CV structure. Extract skills, detect phrasing improvements, and calculate real ATS scores.
Home.feature2Desc: Match your stored CV analysis directly with raw Job Descriptions. Identify missing stack keywords and tech gaps.
Home.feature3Desc: Practice core questions tailored to your resume gaps using Google Gemini. Receive dynamic, structured feedback.
Home.demoBadge: Demo with fictional data: no signup, no real AI
Home.demoTitle: See what SkillRadar sees in your profile
Home.demoSubtitle: Fictional example: 0-based ATS analysis with breakdown, job match, and public GitHub signals.
Home.demoCtaText: This is a sample. With your real CV you get cited evidence, a gap-closing plan, and double-blind for recruiters.
Home.pricingFreeDesc: 5 CV analyses, 3 job matches and 2 mock interviews per month. Enough to optimize your profile.
Home.pricingProDesc: Connect your own API key (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq or OpenRouter) and run without platform limits.
Home.pricingNote: No credit card. Your keys are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never leave the server.
Home.heroVisualCaption: Real score computed with a 0-based rubric. See it live.
Home.howSubtitle: Recruiters evaluate your talent without seeing your personal data until you allow it.
Home.howStep1Desc: We extract skills, seniority and gaps. Your PII never leaves the server unencrypted.
Home.howStep2Desc: Recruiters see DEV-XXXX with scores and justification. No name, email or photo.
Home.howStep3Desc: Your contact details are only enabled when you accept a proposal.
Home.testi1Text: The 0-based breakdown showed me exactly what to fix. I gained 31 points in two iterations.
Home.testi2Text: Double-blind gave me confidence to publish my profile without exposing my email.
Home.testi3Text: BYOK mode with my own key removed the limits. Job matching is accurate.
Home.faqQ1: Do I need a card for the free plan?
Home.faqA1: No. The free plan asks for no card, and the Pro plan uses your own API key with no SkillRadar charges.
Home.faqQ2: What happens to my CV data?
Home.faqA2: It is processed on the server, never exposed raw to recruiter clients, and you can export or delete it (GDPR) from Settings.
Home.faqQ3: How is the ATS score calculated?
Home.faqA3: With a 0-based additive rubric: contact (15) + sections (25) + readability (20) + keywords in context (20) + quantification (20). 100 is unreachable by design.
Home.faqA4: Recruiters see your anonymized profile (DEV-XXXX). Your name and email are only revealed if you accept their contact proposal.
Home.faqQ5: Which AI models can I use?
Home.faqA5: Gemini 3.8/3.7 Flash, GPT-6 Sol/Luna, Claude Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5, Groq and OpenRouter, ours or via BYOK.
Home.faqA6: Spanish and English, switchable across the whole app including analyses and reports.
Home.finalTitle: Stop guessing what an ATS sees
Home.finalSubtitle: Upload your CV and get an evidence-backed diagnosis in under a minute.
Home.demoCvTech: Solid profile in React, TypeScript and Node.js with evidence across 3 projects. Lacks testing and CI/CD depth for the senior band.
Home.demoCvCred: Stack consistent with the stated trajectory. No keyword-stuffing signals: every technology appears in project context.
Home.demoCvSug1: Quantify impact with metrics (users, latency, conversion) using the STAR method.
Home.demoCvSug2: Add a project with a CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions) and automatic deploy.
Home.demoCvSug3: Include a testing section (Jest/Vitest) with coverage in a public repo.
Home.demoCvJust: 78 = contact 11 + sections 18 + readability 20 + context 18 + quantification 11. Solid mid base with upside in metrics and DevOps.
Home.demoMatchRec1: Highlight your Server Components experience on your CV.
Home.demoMatchRec2: Add Vitest testing to your main repo before applying.
Home.demoMatchJust: Strong alignment on the frontend core (5/8 skills with project evidence). Gaps concentrated in DevOps and testing.
Home.demoGhS1: Signal: READMEs with install instructions in 4 repos.
Home.demoGhS2: Signal: TypeScript as primary language with strict typing.
Home.demoGhS3: Signal: sustained activity over the last 6 months.
Home.demoGhW1: Signal: no CI/CD workflows visible in descriptions.
Home.demoGhW2: Signal: few tests detectable by filename.
Home.demoGhSug1: Add CI and coverage badges to your READMEs.
Home.demoGhSug2: Publish a template with Dockerfile + compose for your APIs.
